name: Jacob Alessia
source:
Jacob is Ryne’s best male friend who happens to serve as comedic relief. He is the only male at the local high school’s cooking club. His two goals in life are to be a world-renowned pickup artist, and a celebrity chef. He has eyes for Tristina, although she isn’t too fond of him. Despite that, he is rather stubborn about winning her heart, and doesn’t seem to get the message about her disinterest.

[From the [url=https://pixaelsoft.com/projects/cmd/chara_jacob.php]official site[/url]]
